mentions.h: A dominating win in the semi

mentions.note: won 4 x 100m relay, Golden Jubilee Cup Semi-Final

photos.c: Below: Rachel King, Amala Onuora, Michelle Nestor and Caroline Wilson joined forces to win the 4 x 100m relay at the Golden Jubilee Cup Semi-Final and help push the score along to a massive 313 out of a maximum possible of 342.
